tha-ap125:1.1: suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sambuddho bāttiṁsavaralakkhaṇo → suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṁ sambuddhaṁ battiṁsavaralakkhaṇaṁ (bj, sya-all) | sambuddhaṁ → suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sambuddhe (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap125:1.3: abhinikkhanto bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato → abhinikkhantaṁ bhikkhusaṁghapurakkhataṁ (bj) | abhinikkhanto bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato mahaccā kaṁsapātiyā → abhinikkhantaṁ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṁ sahatthā kaṁsapāṭiyā (sya-all) | Pavanā → padhāno (cck: ka.)
tha-ap125:1.4: bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato → suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṁ …pe… purakkhataṁ-evaṁ dutiyantavasena sī. syā. potthakesu dissati (cck note)
tha-ap125:2.1: mahaccā → sahatthā (bj: PTS, sī.selu) | Mahaccā → sahatthā (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap125:2.2: pāyasaṁ → pāyāsaṁ (bj, sya-all) | pāyasaṁ → pāyāsaṁ (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap125:2.4: upanesiṁ baliṁ → agamiṁ sambaliṁ (sya-all) | upanesiṁ → agamāsiṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap125:6.4: mahāmuni ekanavutito → anuttaro ekanavute ito (sya-all) | mahāmuni → anuttaro (cck: syā.)
tha-ap125:7.4: pāyasassa → pāyāsassa (sya-all) | pāyasassa → pāyāsassa (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap125:10.1: pāyasadāyako → pāyāsadāyako (sya-all) | pāyasadāyako → pāyāsadāyako (cck: syā. ka.)
